high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme that plays on the phrase "Never judge a book by its cover." The top part of the image contains the text "Never judge a book by its cover." Below the text, there are two side-by-side images of a person wearing a plaid dress with thin straps. In the left image, the person is facing forward, and the dress appears to be fitted but not revealing much. In the right image, the person is turning slightly to the side, and the dress is lifted, revealing a significant amount of cleavage.
